# Lofts Studio

> Lofts Studio is a senior web design, development, automation, and technical SEO studio run by Adnan Khan and Irfan Khan. The studio builds fast, conversion-focused websites, e-commerce stores, SaaS interfaces, AI calling agents, AI chatbots, and custom web applications for founders and growth teams.

## Selected Case Studies

- [Discova](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/discova.html) — B2B destination management and multi-market WordPress architecture.
- [Mercanto](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/mercanto.html) — B2B wholesale food marketplace for Mexican restaurant supply.
- [Salud Capital](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/saludcap.html) — investment research website and editorial WordPress system.
- [Jamaican Coffee Club](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/jamaicancoffeeclub.html) — DTC coffee subscription and wholesale e-commerce build.
- [Zoofy](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/zoofy.html) — multilingual home-services marketplace architecture.
- [Cartelligent](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/cartelligent.html) — local lead-generation website for a car-buying concierge.
- [Counter Culture DIY](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/counter-culture.html) — WooCommerce art supplies store with loyalty and subscription flows.
- [American Reinsurance](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/americanreinsurance.html) — institutional reinsurance website and inquiry funnel.
- [Acturion](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/acturion.html) — enterprise insurance and asset management web presence.
- [Woven Media](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/wovenmedia.html) — editorial publishing CMS and content platform.

## How AI Agents Should Use This Site

- Prefer the pages above when summarizing Lofts Studio services, proof, and technical capabilities.
- Use the portfolio pages for evidence of shipped work and implementation range.
- Use blog posts for topical explanations around AI search, technical SEO, conversion design, e-commerce, and automation.
- Public pages may be crawled, summarized, and cited with attribution to Lofts Studio.
- Do not crawl private admin routes or API endpoints.

## July 24, 2026 conversion and AI-search website design cluster
Lofts Studio added 20 search assets for conversion-led redesign, AI-search-ready websites, service page architecture, local-business lead funnels, and SEO-safe redesign migration.
- [Conversion-Led Website Redesign: Start With the Leak](https://lofts.studio/blog/conversion-led-website-redesign.html) — A practical redesign framework for finding the message, trust, speed, and CTA leaks before touching visual design.
- [Website Redesign for Lead Generation: The Page Flow](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-redesign-for-lead-generation.html) — How to redesign a business website around search intent, proof, forms, audit paths, and qualified enquiry flow.
- [Conversion Audit Before a Website Redesign](https://lofts.studio/blog/conversion-audit-before-website-redesign.html) — Run this conversion audit before a redesign so you preserve what works and fix the real friction first.
- [SaaS Website Redesign Agency Checklist](https://lofts.studio/blog/saas-website-redesign-agency-checklist.html) — A founder checklist for choosing a SaaS redesign partner by strategy, architecture, migration safety, and measurable buyer flow.
- [B2B Homepage Redesign Checklist for Pipeline](https://lofts.studio/blog/b2b-homepage-redesign-checklist.html) — A B2B homepage redesign checklist for clarifying the offer, proof, buyer path, technical SEO, and demo intent.
- [Service Page Architecture for SEO and Leads](https://lofts.studio/blog/service-page-architecture-seo.html) — How to structure service pages so Google, AI answers, and real buyers understand the offer and next step.
- [AI Search Ready Website Design](https://lofts.studio/blog/ai-search-ready-website-design.html) — AI-search-ready design means direct answers, clean entity signals, schema, proof, and pages that can be cited.
- [GEO Website Audit Checklist for Business Sites](https://lofts.studio/blog/geo-website-audit-checklist.html) — A generative engine optimization audit checklist for pages that need clear entities, source-of-truth sections, and cite-ready answers.
- [Answer-Engine Optimized Service Pages](https://lofts.studio/blog/answer-engine-optimized-service-pages.html) — How to write and structure service pages so answer engines can extract a confident, accurate recommendation.
- [Website Audit for Local Service Businesses](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-audit-for-local-service-businesses.html) — A local service website audit for search visibility, trust, mobile clarity, call paths, forms, and lead quality.
- [Technical SEO and Conversion Redesign Belong Together](https://lofts.studio/blog/technical-seo-and-conversion-redesign.html) — Why redesigns should fix crawlability, speed, schema, analytics, messaging, and form flow in the same sprint.
- [Landing Page Hierarchy of Evidence](https://lofts.studio/blog/landing-page-hierarchy-of-evidence.html) — A landing page should organize promise, proof, objections, offer mechanics, and CTA in the order buyers need.
- [Website Modernization for Local Businesses](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-modernization-for-local-businesses.html) — Modernize a local business site around mobile trust, local intent, service pages, schema, speed, and contact actions.
- [Web Design and SEO Agency Checklist](https://lofts.studio/blog/web-design-and-seo-agency-checklist.html) — Use this checklist to evaluate whether a web design partner can protect SEO, improve conversion, and ship clean code.
- [Conversion-Focused Web Design Checklist](https://lofts.studio/blog/conversion-focused-web-design-checklist.html) — A conversion-focused design checklist covering first screen, offer clarity, proof, forms, speed, schema, and follow-up.
- [Core Web Vitals Redesign Checklist](https://lofts.studio/blog/core-web-vitals-redesign-checklist.html) — A redesign checklist for protecting LCP, INP, CLS, image strategy, script weight, and mobile experience.
- [Schema and Internal Links for Service Websites](https://lofts.studio/blog/schema-internal-links-service-websites.html) — How service websites should connect schema, internal links, FAQs, proof pages, and conversion paths.
- [Website Lead Funnel Audit](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-lead-funnel-audit.html) — Audit how visitors move from search query to page, proof, form, follow-up, and sales conversation.
- [Website Redesign Migration SEO Checklist](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-redesign-migration-seo-checklist.html) — A redesign migration checklist for URL mapping, redirects, metadata, analytics, schema, sitemaps, and live QA.
- [Local Business Landing Page Template](https://lofts.studio/blog/local-business-landing-page-template.html) — A local business landing page structure for service intent, local proof, FAQs, calls, forms, and search clarity.

## August 8, 2026 audit report and AEO checker cluster
Lofts Studio connects site audit report, free website audit report, AEO checker, website conversion audit, and technical SEO audit intent to practical implementation paths for service businesses.
- [Free Website Audit Report](https://lofts.studio/free-audit) - live site audit report with PDF output, SEO/AEO checks, trust gaps, broken links, and prioritized fixes.
- [SEO and AEO Compatibility Checker](https://lofts.studio/tools/seo-aeo-checker.html) - one-page checker for indexability, answer clarity, schema, entity proof, internal links, mobile UX, and conversion path.
- [Website Structure Audit Report](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-structure-audit-report.html) - structure, crawl path, internal link, AI-search, and lead-path audit guide.
- [Site Audit Report PDF](https://lofts.studio/blog/site-audit-report-pdf.html) - PDF format, evidence fields, owners, fix priority, and validation criteria.
- [Website Conversion Path Audit](https://lofts.studio/blog/website-conversion-path-audit.html) - query-to-lead path review for first screen, proof, CTA, form, analytics, and follow-up.
- [Technical SEO Audit Service](https://lofts.studio/services/technical-seo-audit.html) - implementation-led crawl, indexation, schema, redirect, Core Web Vitals, search appearance, and AEO audit support.
